key_insight: HemAutomaton enables whole-slide white blood cell extraction and profiling without manual region selection, expanding analysis to tens of thousands of cells per smear.
clinical_relevance: For blood cancer assessment—not drug discovery—automated profiling could support more comprehensive differential and blast counting.
method: Use neural cellular automata to extract white blood cells across entire blood and bone marrow smear images.
Apply few-shot classification with a pretrained hematology foundation model for annotation-efficient differential counting.
Analyze slide-wide cell distributions to identify spatial blast-frequency gradients.
evidence_signal: Across three blood cancer cohorts, over 100 million cell images were extracted; detection matched Faster R-CNN in-domain and exceeded it under domain shifts, while automated blast counts agreed with experts within inter-expert variability.
watch_item: Broader clinical validation is needed to establish performance across laboratories, staining protocols, scanners, and patient populations.
paper_title: Exhaustive white blood cell extraction and profiling across whole-slide images of blood and bone marrow smears
